create_OSGDecoder: create an OSGDecoder triplane decoder that produces RGB and sigma values from sampled features
build_TriplaneSynthesizer: build a TriplaneSynthesizer that renders a triplane volume with planes and a camera
run_TriplaneSynthesizer_forward: run the TriplaneSynthesizer forward method to render RGB and depth images from triplane planes and cameras
run_TriplaneSynthesizer_forward_grid: run the TriplaneSynthesizer forward_grid method to query triplane features on a 3D grid
run_TriplaneSynthesizer_forward_points: run the TriplaneSynthesizer forward_points method to query triplane features at arbitrary 3D points
